decisions.reason: As a mobile check-in app is the furthest from the firm's core security strengths and likely underperformed against aspirations in the disrupted airport market, management would reallocate resources to stronger core or platform offerings.

This passenger processing technology fits the firm's strategic push into integrated high-end security and efficiency solutions, and a large firm with some slack would keep it while demand in aviation normalises.

The self-service airline check-in solution is adjacent to the firm's airport operations business and cost-saving value proposition, so management would likely retain it unless results proved clearly and persistently below aspiration.
